sources.title: AI Model Benchmark Tracker 2026 — MMLU, HumanEval, MATH Scores
sources.snippet: MMLU matters because it provides a standardized measure of general knowledge and reasoning ability across diverse domains, making it the most widely cited LLM benchmark. Which AI model is best at coding? On the HumanEval benchmark (Python code generation), Claude Opus 4.6 and o3 lead with pass@1 scores above 90%.

sources.title: Introducing Muse Spark: Scaling Towards Personal Superintelligence
sources.snippet: Muse Spark is a natively multimodal reasoning model with support for tool-use, visual chain of thought, and multi-agent orchestration. Muse Spark is the first step on our scaling ladder and the first product of a ground-up overhaul of our AI efforts.
